hints.tr: Dört tablo gerekiyor: `orders`, `customers`, `order_items` ve `products`. Her `JOIN` bir öncekinin sonucuna ekleniyor.
hints.en: You need four tables: `orders`, `customers`, `order_items` and `products`. Each `JOIN` is added to the result of the previous one.
The links are: `orders.customer_id = customers.id`, `orders.id = order_items.order_id`, `order_items.product_id = products.id`.

hints.tr:
Sorgunun tamamı:

```sql
SELECT o.id AS order_id, c.name AS customer, p.name AS product,
       i.quantity
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.id
JOIN order_items i ON o.id = i.order_id
JOIN products p ON i.product_id = p.id
WHERE o.id = 1005
ORDER BY p.name;
```
hints.en:
The whole query:

```sql
SELECT o.id AS order_id, c.name AS customer, p.name AS product,
       i.quantity
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.id
JOIN order_items i ON o.id = i.order_id
JOIN products p ON i.product_id = p.id
WHERE o.id = 1005
ORDER BY p.name;
```
